about_the_game:
NOTE: Requires POWDER RUNNERS: MAZE QUEST

This DLC unlocks a game mode in the base game.

DLC: CONQUEST SURVIVAL

Enter the maze again, but now victory doesn't depend solely on reaching the center first. A timer tracks the match time, and when the clock hits zero, only the team that dominates the center of the map will be crowned champion.

Test your strategy, withstand the pressure, and fight for supremacy in the heart of the maze!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 de 64 bits or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 7400 or AMD Ryzen 5 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: DirectX 11 or 12-compatible graphics card For best results, high-end hardware is recommended. For example, to take advantage of Nanite, Virtual Shadow Maps, and Lumen, an NVIDIA GTX 1080 or AMD VEGA 64 graphics card or higher is recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 de 64 bits or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 2080 / AMD Radeon RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: DirectX 11 or 12-compatible graphics card For best results, high-end hardware is recommended. For example, to take advantage of Nanite, Virtual Shadow Maps, and Lumen, an NVIDIA GTX 1080 or AMD VEGA 64 graphics card or higher is recommended.

short_description: Own the center of the maze when time runs out and secure victory!
supported_languages: English, Portuguese - Brazil, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Japanese
